cards.card_text: The psalm says God has anointed the one on this throne above his companions with the oil of joy.
cards.verse_text: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.

cards.card_text: Anointed Him with the oil of joy Clothed Him in a robe of gold Gave Him a seat among the angels
cards.verse_text: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy.”
